title: Audio Labelling App Project
description: Project definition. Paths are relative to this file, and may use environment variables as ${NAME}.

label-palette.description: Path to the label palette file. Note that it may be edited and over-written - make sure it is backed up / under version control.

dataset-roots.description: List of read only data set root paths (each root will be searched recursively for audio files

scan-roots.description: Whether the dataset roots are walked to fill the file list. false lists only the recordings the label file and the open review list name, for reviewing lists that draw on large datasets; status and export don't apply then. Default: true

export-prefix.description: Prefix path to export output files, including filename minus extension

channel.description: Channel to view and play, numbered from 1. Default: a mix of all channels. Can be changed per file in the app.

annotations.description: Trees of per-recording label files that mirror the dataset roots, for exchanging labels with other tools: <root>/<path relative to the dataset root, with the label file's extension>

format.description: audacity: start, stop, label (.txt). dcase: onset, offset, event_label (.tsv). raven: a selection table (.Table.1.selections.txt). Default: audacity

naming.description: replace: rec.wav -> rec.txt. append: rec.wav -> rec.wav.txt. Default: replace

import.description: How the files are read. Labels whose text starts with x: are rejected candidates. Default: none (export only)

export.description: Whether the app writes the files. Default: true

export-files.description: done: only files marked done, each written even with no labels, so an empty file means checked with no events. all: also files with labels not marked done. Default: done

include-suggestions.description: Also write suggestions not yet reviewed. Default: false

empty-means-done.description: An empty file marks its recording done on import. Default: true, except for trees imported as suggestions

high-pass.description: A high-pass filter for wind and handling noise, applied when audio is read: to the waveform, spectrogram, playback and the built-in loudness labeller, not to exported clips. Zero phase (forwards and backwards), so sounds don't move in time. Every key is optional.

order.description: Butterworth order of each pass. Default: 4

review.description: How labels are played and shown while checking them. Every key is optional.

pre_roll_s.description: Played before a label, which plays to its stop. Default: 0.2

point_post_s.description: Played after the start of a zero-length label, which has no stop. Default: 0.5

onset_pre_s.description: Read as pre_roll_s if that's missing

onset_post_s.description: Read as point_post_s if that's missing

view_pre_s.description: Shown before a suggestion, and after its stop, in review mode. Default: 0.5

view_post_s.description: Shown at least this long after a suggestion's start in review mode. Default: 1

snap_window_s.description: How far snapping (A) may move a label's start. Default: 0.005

snap_regions.description: Whether snapping also moves the starts of regions, not only zero-length labels. Default: false

by_score.description: Review the lowest scores first, if suggestions have scores. Default: true

assisted-labellers.description: Detectors that propose suggestions to review: external programs run once per recording, or built-ins. A built-in loudness labeller is listed even if not configured.

command.description: Program and arguments (preferred: no quoting needed), or one string run through cmd.exe or /bin/sh. Placeholders: {audio}, {output} (the label file to write; without it, standard output is read), {relative}, {root}, {project_dir}, {channel}, {class}. It must exit with 0.

format.description: Of what the command writes. Default: audacity

builtin.description: A built-in instead of a command

class.description: Class of a built-in's suggestions. Default: chosen in the app

options.description: Loudness: margin_db (12), min_level_db (-70), floor_percentile (0.2), frame_s (0.01), min_length_s (0.03), merge_gap_s (0.1), padding_s (0.01), snap_starts (false: start each region at its sharpest rise rather than padding before it; read from onsets in older projects)

clip-manifest.description: Review lists: CSVs of events to hear and judge, eg. from a training pipeline. A list in the app's own format (see examples/review-list.csv) needs none of this; the section names a list to open with the project, and renames the columns of another tool's CSV. Reviewing never changes the labels: results are written beside the list, run.csv giving run.results.csv and run.results.json.

path.description: The list to open with the project, relative to this file

clip-root.description: Clip paths are relative to this. Default: the list's folder

columns.description: Column names, for a CSV not in the app's own format

source.description: The recording, relative to a dataset root, or absolute. Default: path

start.description: The event's start in the recording, in seconds. Default: start_s

stop.description: Optional: the event's stop in the recording, in seconds. Default: stop_s

duration.description: Optional, used if there's no stop: the event's length from its start, in seconds. Default: duration_s

label.description: Optional: the class the pipeline gave it. Default: label

root.description: Optional: the row's dataset root, as written in dataset-roots. Default: root

channel.description: Optional: the channel of the recording to view and play, from 1. Default: channel

clip.description: Optional: a cut clip, shown when the recording isn't in the project. Default: clip_path

clip_offset.description: Required with a clip: where the clip starts in its recording, in seconds; negative if it starts with padding. Default: clip_offset_s

id.description: Optional: a key the results are joined on. Default: id

dataset-root.description: The dataset root paths are relative to, for rows without a root, as written in dataset-roots. Default: try each

match_s.description: Importing review edits: a label whose span holds a row's start, give or take this, is the row's label. Default: 0.05

region_s.description: The length a row without a stop or duration is drawn and played with. Default: 1

export.description: Clip export settings. Every key is optional.

directory.description: Output directory, relative to this file. Default: dataset

mode.description: padded: each label plus padding, merging labels whose clips would overlap. fixed: a window of fixed length centred on each label. Default: padded

padding_s.description: Padding before and after each label, and the gap kept between background clips and labels. Default: 0.5

fixed_length_s.description: Clip length in fixed mode. Default: 10

max_clip_s.description: Merging stops before a clip would exceed this. Default: 30

background_per_file.description: Clips with no labels, from files marked done. Default: 0
